questionText:
Match List-I with List-II
List-I (Structure of Protein) List-II (Function)
(A) Primary Structure
(I) Gives rise to Fibrous and Globular Proteins
(B) Secondary structure
(II) Sequence of amino acid
(C) Tertiary Structure
(III) shape of polypeptide chain
(D) Quaternary Structure
(IV) Spatial arrangement of sub-units
Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.
Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.
Correct answer. Accurately solves the problem for Structure of Proteins.
Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
For Structure of Proteins (Biomolecules):
Step 1: Primary Structure refers to the sequence of amino acids ((A) -> (II)). Step 2: Secondary structure refers to the shape of the polypeptide chain ((B) -> (III)). Step 3: Tertiary structure gives rise to fibrous and globular proteins ((C) -> (I)). Step 4: Quaternary structure refers to the spatial arrangement of subunits ((D) -> (IV)).

Therefore, option (C) is the correct answer.
